subject: Media Literacy
title: Fear-Based Advertising
description: Learn Fear-Based Advertising in one minute.

hook.text: An insurance ad shows a family losing their home after a disaster. You call your agent the next day.

buildup.text: Fear appeals work by presenting a threat and offering the product as protection or solution.

discovery.text: Studies show moderate fear is most effective. Too little is ignored; too much causes avoidance.

twist.text: Security cameras, insurance, health products — entire industries are built on manufactured anxiety.

climax.text: When an ad makes you feel unsafe, ask whether the danger is real or the fear is the product.

punchline.text: They sell the fear first. Then they sell the fix.

quiz.question: How do fear-based ads persuade consumers?
options: By presenting a threat and offering the product as protection
